title: A New Opportunity
description: Your manager calls you into the office with exciting news. A new position has opened up — higher salary, more responsibility, and significantly more stress. The role may require relocating.

choices.text: Accept the promotion eagerly
Ask for a week to think it over
Decline and stay in your current role

title: Office Politics
description: You discover that a colleague has been taking credit for your work in team meetings. Your manager seems to believe them. Confronting this could be risky — but staying silent may cost you more.

choices.text: Confront the colleague directly and privately
Raise it professionally with your manager
Document everything quietly and wait
Ignore it and focus on your next project

title: Performance Review
description: Your annual review is here. Your manager praises your technical skills but flags poor communication. You can use this moment to negotiate a raise — or simply accept the feedback.

choices.text: Negotiate confidently for a raise
Accept the feedback and set improvement goals
Push back firmly on the negative feedback

title: Crushing Workload
description: Three major projects land on your desk simultaneously with overlapping deadlines. You are already stretched thin. This could be your chance to prove yourself — or it could break you.

choices.text: Take it all on — prove yourself
Delegate tasks to teammates
Talk to your manager about reprioritising
Quietly do the minimum to survive

title: A Mentor Appears
description: A senior leader takes a genuine interest in your career. They offer to mentor you — but it means monthly evening meetings and extra assignments on top of your regular work.

choices.text: Eagerly accept — the long-term value is clear
Accept but negotiate clear limits on time
Politely decline — you need your evenings

title: Competitor Comes Calling
description: A rival company reaches out through LinkedIn with a 40% salary hike and a senior title. It is tempting, but starting fresh in an unfamiliar culture is a real risk.

choices.text: Accept the offer — the jump is worth it
Use the offer to negotiate a raise where you are
Decline — loyalty and stability matter to you

title: Startup Invitation
description: A college friend invites you to co-found a startup. The idea is exciting and early funding looks promising — but it means leaving stable employment with no guarantee of success.

choices.text: Quit and join full-time — go all in
Advise part-time while keeping your job
Decline — the risk is too high right now

title: Project Collapse
description: A high-visibility project you were leading has failed publicly. The client is unhappy, your manager is disappointed, and your team is demoralized. How you handle the fallout will define your next chapter.

choices.text: Take full accountability and present a recovery plan
Share responsibility honestly with the team
Quietly shift blame to external factors

title: Employee of the Quarter
description: You have been selected as Employee of the Quarter. Your name will be announced company-wide and you will receive a cash bonus. All the hard work is finally paying off.

choices.text: Accept proudly and share the credit with your team
Accept quietly — you prefer not to be in the spotlight

title: Team Clash
description: Weeks of tension with a colleague erupted in a team meeting today. The conflict is now visible to management and it needs to be addressed one way or another.

choices.text: Initiate a calm one-on-one to resolve it
Ask HR to mediate
Ignore it and hope it blows over

title: Upskilling Opportunity
description: Your company is sponsoring a certification in an emerging technology. It is free, but requires three months of evenings and weekends. A worthwhile sacrifice — or is it?

choices.text: Enrol and commit fully
Enrol but pace yourself
Skip it — you need the break

title: Company Downsizing
description: Your company announces layoffs affecting 20% of staff. You are not on the list — but three colleagues are, including a close work friend. The office mood has turned very bleak.

choices.text: Help your friend job-hunt — be their support system
Focus on securing your own position
Start quietly looking for a new job yourself

title: Overworked
description: You have been working 12-hour days for three straight months. Your body is protesting and your personal life has shrunk to almost nothing. Something has to give.

choices.text: Take a full week off — your body needs it urgently
Reduce hours gradually and set firm boundaries
Push through — the milestone is so close

title: Side Hustle Beckons
description: A freelance project lands in your inbox — it pays well but would consume your weekends for two months. It is outside your core expertise but genuinely exciting.

choices.text: Take it — the extra income is worth the sacrifice
Negotiate for a smaller, manageable scope
Decline — weekends are sacred

title: Industry Conference
description: Your company is sending you to a prestigious industry conference in another city. Three days of networking, workshops, and a chance to be noticed by the right people.

choices.text: Go and network aggressively
Go and focus mostly on learning
Skip it — too much happening at work right now

title: An Old Friend Returns
description: Someone you haven't spoken to in years reaches out wanting to reconnect. Part of you is excited, part cautious — you remember why you drifted apart.

choices.text: Meet them for coffee and genuinely reconnect
Reply warmly but keep your distance for now
Ignore the message

title: A Romantic Interest
description: Someone catches your eye — or perhaps you have caught theirs. There is a clear spark. Pursuing this could bring real joy, but it will take time and emotional energy you may not have.

choices.text: Ask them out — take the leap
Build a genuine friendship first, take it slow
Focus on yourself — this is not the right time

title: A Painful Falling Out
description: A misunderstanding escalated into a serious argument with someone you care about. Words were said that cannot be easily unsaid. The friendship is hanging in the balance.

choices.text: Apologise first — the relationship matters more than being right
Give it time to cool, then have a proper conversation
Stand your ground — you were not wrong

title: Family Reconnection
description: You have grown distant from a family member you once loved spending time with. Life got in the way. Now they have reached out after a long silence.

choices.text: Reach out immediately and plan a proper visit
Reply warmly and keep it light for now
The distance is intentional — leave it be

title: A New Friend
description: You instantly click with a new colleague. They share your interests and bring a refreshing perspective. A genuine friendship feels possible — but only if you invest the effort.

choices.text: Invite them for lunch — invest in the friendship
Keep it casual — a friendly work relationship is enough
Stay focused — you have enough on your plate

title: A Friend in Crisis
description: A close friend calls in tears. They are going through something serious — a breakup, job loss, or mental health crisis. They need you, and you are the only person they have called.

choices.text: Drop everything and be fully present for them
Offer support within your own limits
You are barely keeping it together yourself

title: Social Media Trouble
description: An old post of yours resurfaced and is being widely criticised online. It was taken out of context, but the damage is spreading and your colleagues and family have seen it.

choices.text: Post a clear and thoughtful public apology
Delete the post and say nothing
Post a follow-up explaining the full context

title: Community Service
description: A local NGO needs volunteers for an environmental drive this weekend. The time commitment is real but the cause feels genuinely meaningful to you.

choices.text: Give the whole weekend — go all in
Volunteer for just one day
Donate money instead of time

title: A Chance Encounter
description: You run into someone unexpectedly — an old flame, a childhood friend, or someone whose life once intersected powerfully with yours. The encounter stirs up old feelings and forgotten memories.

choices.text: Stop and have a genuine, unhurried conversation
Exchange pleasantries and move on gracefully
Slip away before they notice you

title: Growing Apart
description: You and a close friend have been on different paths. Calls have become shorter, meetings rarer. You sense the friendship is quietly slipping away unless someone makes the first move.

choices.text: Plan a trip together — reconnect properly
Send a heartfelt message and reach out
Accept that people grow apart — let it go

title: Wedding Invitation
description: A good friend is getting married and you are invited. The wedding is in another city and the full trip will be expensive — but missing it would be a hard relationship to recover from.

choices.text: Attend and celebrate fully — be there for them
Attend the main ceremony, keep the trip short
Send a thoughtful gift and your sincere regrets

title: Neighbourhood Dispute
description: A long-simmering disagreement with a neighbour became unavoidable today — they confronted you directly in front of others. The whole building is watching how you handle this.

choices.text: Stay calm and actively seek a fair solution
Stand your ground — you are clearly in the right
Escalate formally to the housing society

title: A Financial Decision
description: You have accumulated some savings and a financial advisor lays out your options: equity markets for higher returns, or a stable fixed deposit for peace of mind.

choices.text: Invest aggressively in equities
Go with the safe fixed deposit
Spend it on experiences instead

title: Unexpected Medical Bill
description: A family member requires an urgent procedure. The hospital bill is significant and insurance covers only a portion of it. You need to act quickly.

choices.text: Pay the full bill without hesitation
Set up an EMI plan with the hospital
Appeal the insurance and delay payment

title: Investment Pitch
description: An acquaintance with a history of successful ventures pitches you a real estate opportunity. The returns look exceptional on paper — and so does the risk.

choices.text: Invest a significant amount — high risk, high reward
Invest a small, manageable amount to test it
Decline — if it sounds too good, it usually is

title: Budget Crisis
description: Monthly expenses have been creeping up and this month you are dangerously close to zero. Something has to give — either cut back immediately or find a quick bridge.

choices.text: Cut all non-essentials for two months
Take a small personal loan to bridge the gap
Ask a trusted family member for help

title: Credit Card Spiral
description: You have been using credit heavily for months and the debt has crept to a worrying level. The interest is compounding. It is time to deal with it seriously.

choices.text: Clear the entire balance — bite the bullet
Build a structured repayment plan over three months
Minimum payments only — deal with it later

title: Year-End Bonus
description: Your company announces a year-end performance bonus — more than you expected. How you use this windfall could shape your finances for the next year.

choices.text: Invest half in mutual funds, spend the rest wisely
Use it entirely to pay off outstanding debt
Treat yourself and your loved ones generously
Save every rupee as an emergency fund

title: Vehicle Breakdown
description: Your vehicle breaks down on the way to work. The mechanic says it needs major repairs. Repair it, replace it, or manage without it — each option has a real cost.

choices.text: Repair it properly — you need reliable transport
Buy a good used vehicle instead
Use public transport and save the repair cost

title: Festival Season Spending
description: Festival season has arrived along with social and family expectations — gifts, celebrations, new clothes, travel. The pressure to spend is real, but so is the joy.

choices.text: Celebrate fully and embrace the season
Celebrate thoughtfully within a sensible budget
Keep it minimal this year — you cannot afford it

title: Freelance Windfall
description: A project you pitched months ago is suddenly approved and the client transfers a large advance. This is more than you expected — and you need to decide quickly what to do with it.

choices.text: Invest half and use the rest wisely
Save the entire amount as a security cushion
Use it to meaningfully upgrade your lifestyle

title: Home Repair Emergency
description: Your bathroom ceiling develops a serious leak after heavy rain. Left unaddressed it becomes a far bigger problem — but the contractor's quote is steep.

choices.text: Fix it properly with a professional — do it right
Do a temporary patch job to buy some time
Get three quotes and negotiate aggressively

title: An Unexpected Health Scare
description: You wake up feeling unwell and visit a doctor. Test results show you need to make lifestyle changes immediately. The doctor recommends medication and a significant reduction in stress.

choices.text: Follow the doctor's advice strictly
Rest and try home remedies for now
Ignore the symptoms and push through

title: Gym Dilemma
description: A new gym opened near your home with a reasonable membership offer. Getting fit could pay real dividends — but it takes time and discipline you are not sure you have.

choices.text: Join and commit to five sessions a week
Join and go whenever you realistically can
Exercise at home — free and flexible
Skip it — absolutely no time right now

title: Mental Health Check
description: You have been feeling persistently low — unmotivated, anxious, disconnected from everything. A friend suggests seeing a therapist. The idea feels both necessary and daunting.

choices.text: Book an appointment — you deserve real support
Start with journaling and daily meditation
Open up to a trusted friend or family member
Push through it alone — you always have

title: Seasonal Illness
description: The changing season brought a bad flu that has knocked you flat for a week. You have important work pending but your body is flat-out refusing to cooperate.

choices.text: Rest completely — your body clearly needs it
Rest at home but handle the most urgent emails
Power through with medication and caffeine

title: Dietary Reckoning
description: Your doctor points out that your diet has been consistently poor — too much processed food, insufficient nutrition. A significant change is needed before it leads to chronic problems.

choices.text: Overhaul your diet completely — go all in
Make gradual, sustainable improvements
Acknowledge the advice but change nothing

title: Workplace Injury
description: A painful sprain or strain from long hours at a bad workstation is getting worse. It is manageable now but could become chronic if you ignore it much longer.

choices.text: See a physiotherapist and follow the full plan
Rest and use self-care remedies at home
Ignore it and keep working — no time for this

title: Sleepless Nights
description: Your mind races the moment you lie down. You have been struggling to sleep for weeks and it is affecting your concentration, mood, and physical health in ways you can no longer ignore.

choices.text: Establish a strict sleep routine and cut screens
Consult a doctor about sleep aids
Push through on caffeine as always

title: Dental Emergency
description: A severe toothache you have been ignoring for weeks becomes unbearable. The dentist says you need a root canal. The cost is significant and the procedure is deeply uncomfortable.

choices.text: Go ahead with the root canal — deal with it properly
Choose extraction — it is faster and cheaper
Take painkillers and delay the decision

title: Annual Check-Up
description: It has been over a year since your last health check-up. Your doctor sends a gentle reminder. You feel fine — but preventive checks catch things that feeling fine cannot.

choices.text: Book a comprehensive full-body health check
Go for a basic check-up only
Skip it — you genuinely feel fine

title: Burnout Warning
description: You have not had a real break in months. Colleagues notice you seem different — less present, more irritable. Your body is sending unmistakable signals that something needs to change.

choices.text: Take a proper two-week vacation and fully disconnect
Take a long weekend and make it count
Reduce your workload for the next month
Push on — you cannot afford to stop right now

title: A Family Gathering
description: Your extended family is hosting a large gathering this weekend. Relatives you haven't seen in years will be there — an opportunity to reconnect, or to deal with the usual family dynamics.

choices.text: Attend and engage genuinely with everyone
Attend but keep to yourself
Skip it — you are genuinely too busy

title: Parents Need Help
description: Your parents are facing financial difficulty and have reluctantly come to you for support. They need a meaningful amount of money and they have no other real option.

choices.text: Help them fully — family always comes first
Help with what you can genuinely afford
Explain honestly that you cannot help right now

title: Milestone Celebration
description: A family member has achieved something significant — a graduation, promotion, or major personal milestone. The family wants a celebration and expects you to play a leading role.

choices.text: Organise and fund a truly memorable celebration
Contribute meaningfully and share the load
Attend but keep your contribution minimal

title: Sibling Rift
description: A long-standing tension with a sibling erupts over a family matter. Other relatives are taking sides. The rift feels wider than it has ever been.

choices.text: Initiate a calm, private conversation to work it out
Stay out of it and wait for things to cool naturally
Stand your ground regardless of the fallout

title: Family Business Crisis
description: The family business is struggling — revenues have fallen and closure is being discussed. You are asked to step in and help with decisions, though this was never part of your plan.

choices.text: Get fully involved and try to turn it around
Provide strategic advice without taking operations
Stay out of it — it is not your responsibility

title: Unexpected Houseguest
description: A family member arrived for a few days but has now stayed for weeks. Your personal space and daily routine are significantly disrupted and the situation keeps extending.

choices.text: Welcome them warmly and adapt your routine
Have an honest, kind conversation about timelines
Tolerate it silently — family is family

title: Elder Care Decision
description: An elderly grandparent can no longer live independently. The family must decide between home care, a professional facility, or one family member taking primary responsibility.

choices.text: Take primary responsibility yourself
Pool resources for quality professional home care
Arrange a well-regarded care facility

title: A Quiet Weekend
description: You have an unexpectedly free weekend with no obligations at all. The city is alive with possibilities and you feel the rare gift of completely unstructured time.

choices.text: Rest at home and completely recharge
Explore the city and see where the day takes you
Pick up a new hobby you have been putting off

title: A Lucky Find
description: You discover an old gift card with balance, a forgotten fixed deposit maturity, or a reimbursement never claimed. A small but genuinely welcome windfall appears from nowhere.

choices.text: Save every rupee of it — be responsible
Treat yourself to something small and meaningful
Donate it — you have enough

title: Monsoon Mayhem
description: Heavy rains have flooded the roads, disrupted transport, and brought the city to a crawl for days. Your commute has tripled in length and your entire schedule is in chaos.

choices.text: Work from home and embrace the slower pace
Battle the commute every day — commitments come first
Take a couple of official days off and reset

title: Surprise Day Off
description: An unexpected public holiday is announced at short notice. You have no plans. This is a rare, entirely unscheduled free day — completely yours to use however you wish.

choices.text: Visit somewhere you have been meaning to explore
Stay home — rest, read, and genuinely decompress
Use the time to get ahead on work

title: Power Outage
description: A prolonged power cut hits your neighbourhood for three days. No air conditioning in the heat, disrupted routines — a reminder of how dependent modern life has become on electricity.

choices.text: Take it in stride — improvise and adapt cheerfully
Check into a hotel for the duration
Use the forced downtime to truly disconnect

title: A Stray Needs Help
description: An injured stray dog appears at your doorstep. It is clearly in pain and afraid. Helping it will cost time, money, and emotional energy — but leaving it feels genuinely wrong.

choices.text: Take it to the vet and get it properly treated
Contact a local animal rescue organisation
Leave food and water — that is all you can manage

title: Local Festival
description: Your neighbourhood is hosting a vibrant local festival — music, street food, cultural performances, and the warm beautiful chaos of community life at its most joyful.

choices.text: Dive in fully — embrace the celebration completely
Drop by for a few hours and take it all in
Watch from your balcony — enjoy it from a quiet distance

title: Online Course Discovery
description: You stumble upon an online course on something you have always been curious about — photography, writing, coding, or something entirely different. It is affordable and self-paced.

choices.text: Enrol and commit properly to completing it
Start it casually with no pressure
Bookmark it for later — no realistic time right now
